standards: Direct operator/hotel pages preferred; chain city locators labelled as such.
Indexed operator text distinguished from successful direct retrieval.
Descriptions summarize operator offerings, not independent quality endorsements.
Do not publish Tripadvisor links, rankings, review counts or review text.
No images reused and no outreach or bookings made.
next_checks: Resolve held venue identities and branch-specific links.
Confirm current operating status, menu, address and facilities before public recommendation.

browser_followup.result: Successfully opened in browser after web text retrieval failed. Rendered operator menu and footer name Indian, Chinese and Tandoori cuisine and Nayapalli and Kalinga Nagar outlets. Resolves prior live-link recheck requirement. No ordering or contact action taken.
